source: knowledge/mentor/discipline/short-selling.md (mentor text 做空学, verbatim; this spec is DK 整理, not mentor content)
implementation: src/options/shortside.ts shortEntryChecks (plan card §9 for --dir bear; paper open side=short → JournalEntry.shortChecklist, practice also warnTags)
hardRequirement: Only the written plan card (thesis, stop or invalidation, take-profit plan) is hard for practice trades; nothing in this spec blocks a trade.
scope: Phase 1 bearish views via defined-risk structures only (long puts / put debit spreads). Short stock and covered puts are phase-2 reference only, not enabled (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-17).

conventions.bars: daily OHLC, oldest first; bar[-1] = entry day (entry at its close for backtests; may be a live bar in production); bar[-2] = prior day
conventions.returns: close-to-close % over N bars; benchmark bars aligned to the underlying's dates (common dates only)
conventions.atr: simple average of true range over atrPeriod bars
conventions.realizedVol: annualised stdev of log close-to-close returns over 20 bars × sqrt(252), in %
conventions.broadEtfs: SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, sector ETFs (SMH, XL*), TLT, HYG, GLD, GDX, UUP, IBIT, KRE, XBI, ARKK: no sector benchmark, no single-stock squeeze check

items.text: Don't short a strong uptrend; 'up too much' is not a reason. Wait for it to start falling.
items.formula: close > SMA(maFast) AND SMA(maFast) > SMA(maSlow) AND SMA(maSlow) > SMA(maSlow) maSlopeLookback bars ago

items.text: Short the weak, not the strong: it should already lag the index AND its sector/peers.
items.formula: warn if ret(rsLookback) >= SPY ret(rsLookback) OR ret(rsLookback) >= sector ret(rsLookback); ret(rsShortLookback) reported only; peers beyond the sector ETF are manual

items.text: Don't chase after it is already on the floor; best entries are failed rebounds to resistance.
items.formula: warn if (entry / prior close − 1)×100 <= chaseDayDropPct OR entry < prior-day low OR (SMA(maFast) − entry) / ATR(atrPeriod) >= chaseStretchAtr

items.text: Preferred entry: a rebound reached resistance and failed.
items.formula: info (not a warning): some bar in the last reboundLookback bars (excluding entry bar) had high >= its SMA(maFast), AND entry < SMA(maFast), AND entry <= that window's max high − ATR(atrPeriod)

items.text: Junk can double before it goes to zero (short interest, low float, gamma, sentiment).
items.formula: warn if max single-day % gain over the last squeezeUpDayLookback bars >= squeezeUpDayPct OR realizedVol(20) >= squeezeRvolPct. Proxy only — not short-interest data.

items.text: Write the squeeze check: short interest % float, float size, option gamma, meme/retail sentiment.
items.formula: warn if no squeeze note (single stocks only); negative dealer gamma from gex.ts is shown in the detail when available

items.text: Being two weeks early can kill you: the structure must survive until the thesis can play out.
items.formula: warn if frontDTE < (horizon or defaultHorizonDays) + earlyBufferDays, OR timeStopAt > front expiry

items.text: Pre-write where the thesis is wrong (hard: plan card); for a short it must sit above the entry.
An automatic check could not run (missing bars / benchmark / sector mapping); judge it manually.
items.formula: warn listing every check that lacked data (trend needs maSlow+maSlopeLookback bars; RS needs rsLookback+1 aligned bars)

items.text: Short what the narrative is leaving and money is exiting, not the crowded hot stock.
items.formula: manual checklist item; possible future OHLCV proxy (down-day volume > up-day volume over 20 bars) is NOT implemented

items.text: If price action separates from the thesis, get out; don't argue with the market.
items.formula: backtest candidate: exit at first close > invalidationLevel, or when ret since entry > benchmark ret since entry by more than ATR%-scaled margin (margin TBD). Live: manual review question only.

items.text: Panic gives short profits and takes them back fast: take profits into panic, staged.
items.formula: backtest candidate: while in profit, a bar with (prior close − close) >= 2 × ATR(atrPeriod) → take a tranche. Live: plan card §5 staged take-profit (tpplan.ts) + review question.

items.text: Thesis wrong → admit; size wrong → cut; timing wrong → leave. 'But I was right in the end' does not count.

notEnabled.reason: unlimited upside risk, borrow cost, recall; naked/undefined-risk shorts are refused (rules.ts defined_risk; practice: max loss undefined is hard)
short stock + short put: profit capped at the put strike, no protection against an upside squeeze, adds assignment obligation; phase-2 reference only
